questions.question:
**Direction: Choose the appropriate one-word substitution:**

One who plans and draws the design of buildings and superintends their construction.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'****Architect****.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let us see the meanings of the given options:

 
 
• **Compositor: **a person who arranges type for printing or keys text into a composing machine. (एक व्यक्ति जो एक कंपोज़िंग मशीन में प्रिंटिंग या कीज़ टेक्स्ट के लिए टाइप की व्यवस्था करता है)
 
• **Designer: **a person whose job is to make drawings or plans showing how something will be made. (डिज़ाइनर; किसी वस्‍तु के निर्माण की रूपरेखा बनाने वाला वेशभूषाकार)
 
• **Draughtsman: **a person whose job is to do technical drawings. (तकनीकी आरेख या नक्‍़शे बनाने वाला, नक्‍़शानवीस)
 
• **Architect: **a person whose job is to design buildings. (भवन-निर्माण की योजना बनाने वाला व्‍यक्ति; वास्‍तुशिल्‍पी, स्‍थापत्‍यविद)
 
 
 
• From the meanings of the given words, one who plans and draws the design of buildings and superintends their construction is 'Architect.'
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 4.

An act of treating a holy place or object in a way that does not show proper respect
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**sacrilege**"

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the expression given is 'Sacrilege'. Sacrilege refers to the act of violating or showing disrespect towards something that is considered sacred or holy. 
 
 
• **For example,** *if someone vandalizes a church or damages a religious artifact, this would be considered a **sacrilege**.*
 
 

**Hence, the correct answer is **"*sacrilege*."

• **For example,** *if someone cheats on their partner, this would be considered **infidelity**.*
 
 
 
• **Hypergamy** - Hypergamy refers to the practice of marrying someone of a higher social status or wealth. 
 
 
• **For example, ***if a woman marries a man who is more educated or has more money than her, this would be considered **hypergamy**.*
 
 
 
• **Restitution** - Restitution refers to the act of making amends or compensating for damages that were done. 
 
 
• **For example,** *if someone causes damage to another person's property, they may be ordered to make **restitution** by paying for the repairs.*

questions.question:
Choose one word substitution for the following phrase.

A mild or indirect expression substituted for a harsh and offensive one.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"euphemism"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Let's understand the given one-words:

__
 
• **Euphemism**__: A euphemism is a mild or indirect word or expression used in place of one considered to be too harsh or blunt when referring to something unpleasant or embarrassing.

 __
 
• For example, instead of saying "he died", one might say "he passed away".
 
 
 
• **Metaphor**__: A metaphor is a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable. It is used to describe something by referring to something else, suggesting a comparison between the two.
 __
 
• For example, "The world is a stage" is a metaphor that compares the world to a theatrical performance.
 
 
 
• **Epigram:**__ An epigram is a brief, clever, and memorable statement that makes a pointed statement or observation. It often has a humorous or sarcastic tone.
 __
 
• For example, "I have a fear of speed bumps, but I'm slowly getting over it."
 
 
 
• **Simile:**__ A simile is a figure of speech that makes a comparison between two unlike things, using the words "like" or "as". It is used to describe something by comparing it to something else.
 __
 
• For example, "She sings like an angel" is a simile that compares the singer's voice to the voice of an angel.
 
 
 
• Thus, from the above explanation it is clear that the correct one word for the given group of words is "Euphemism"

***​Correct answer:***__ Euphemism
